hub.title: Games
chicken.title: Chicken Pursuit
chicken.instructions: You and another chicken race to the food. Arrow keys, the pad, and a tap on the yard all stay with the screen. When the yard turns, that same direction takes a different path. The bar fills until the next turn. The arrow points north. Space or Enter starts the next race.
void.title: Void Run
void.instructions: Fly with WASD or the arrow keys. On a touch screen, drag. A click stays put and aims the guns. Hold Space or hold the press to shoot the ships and rocks. Each hit costs hull. Space or the button starts the next run.
